items.quote: Several respondents noted that Veya Ashani set the direction for an ethics review of conflict-of-interest declarations across the public service.
Peers observed that Veya championed the partnership with sister agencies on youth services and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Veya contributed effectively to the organisational restructuring of the department.
Peers observed that Veya Ashani delivered their share of coaching and mentoring junior officers reliably.
Several respondents noted that Veya Ashani delivered their share of reaching a deal with the contractor after weeks of back-and-forth reliably.
Peers observed that Veya Ashani handled mapping interdependencies across agencies competently within their team.
Direct reports said that Veya Ashani took ownership of dashboards tracking service performance metrics and steered it to completion.
Direct reports said that Veya Ashani was recognised sector-wide for their leadership of the five-year strategic plan for the division.
Direct reports said that Veya was recognised sector-wide for their leadership of adoption of new technology tools for case officers.
Several respondents noted that Veya spearheaded public communications on the new scheme at the national level.
